{"content":"# gh-998 — RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: A placeholder check-run in `in_progress`/`queued` whose owning workflow run has already terminated becomes unreachable state — it pins `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` forever and no machine action can merge the PR.

**Root cause**: In this repo, the SM tick itself registers the long-lived pending placeholder stamps (`stampValidationChecksForModule(..., 'in_progress', null, null)` — js/smAgent.js, the validate-pr arm at ~line 2877, the gh-852 fresh-sha reset at ~line 2835, and the gh-821 zombie re-dispatch at ~line 3496). The close obligation for those placeholders is only honored on ONE of the cycle's five outcomes:

- **success** — closed in place, but ONLY when the head additionally carries a completed-success dispatched validation run (`greenCoverRun`) AND no active run AND `silentToken` is configured (gh-857 block, ~line 2696). Any fail-safe miss (a kicker run active on the head at tick time, no app token, a degraded probe) leaves the zombie in place.
- **failure / superseded / cancelled / died** — NO close path exists at all. The gh-865 block (~line 2661) detects the numeric-id orphan twin (pending check whose owning run concluded) but the in-place conclusion is gated on the same green-cover condition; without a cover, orphan-only heads "fall through to the legacy dispatch below" — a same-sha re-dispatch that gh-865's own comment says cannot cure "a stamp nothing will ever conclude". Link-less placeholders without a cover burn the capped gh-852 fresh-sha reset (3 per 2h) and then PARK the PR.
- **pre-fix leaks** — no sweeper exists; zombies minted before this fix stay `in_progress` on their SHA forever (platform auto-fail is unreliable; operator REST close 404s — creator-only, I4).

The live instance (fa #1563, 2026-10-17, head `f3d58647`): kicker-suite 105847141092 created by the push at 18:15:41Z; placeholder `Quality gate` (check-run 117469671401) registered 18:24:18Z stayed `in_progress` 40+ minutes past its cycle while a genuine `Quality gate: success` existed from the real CI run — PR hard-stuck at BLOCKED; operator could not close it via REST (404 creator-only).

**Impact**: any PR whose validation cycle ends without landing a verdict stamp on the head (superseded by a newer head, cancelled, dup dispatch, tick death between arm and verdict) keeps a pending required check pinned on its current head. GitHub computes required-check state per name across ALL suites on the head, so one zombie holds BLOCKED even with 58 green siblings. The merge bot waits `checks=pending` every tick; the branch is not behind so no re-validation cycle helps.

**Fix approach** (per the ticket's tiered inventory, defaults Q1–Q3):
1. **Finally-path, no-verdict rows (core, this repo)**: when the head carries terminal-owner orphans (gh-865 detector — pending check-run whose owning run concluded, past the propagation grace) and the cycle left NO verdict (no green cover) and NO active run on the head (gh-857 AC2 fail-safe), force-complete the orphans as **`neutral`** under the cycle's own app token (I3: a superseded/dead cycle carries no verdict about its head; I4: same-app token, no cross-app completion). {"content":"# gh-998 — RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: A placeholder check-run in `in_progress`/`queued` whose owning workflow run has already terminated becomes unreachable state — it pins `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` forever and no machine action can merge the PR.

**Root cause**: In this repo, the SM tick itself registers the long-lived pending placeholder stamps (`stampValidationChecksForModule(..., 'in_progress', null, null)` — js/smAgent.js, the validate-pr arm at ~line 2877, the gh-852 fresh-sha reset at ~line 2835, and the gh-821 zombie re-dispatch at ~line 3496). The close obligation for those placeholders is only honored on ONE of the cycle's five outcomes:

- **success** — closed in place, but ONLY when the head additionally carries a completed-success dispatched validation run (`greenCoverRun`) AND no active run AND `silentToken` is configured (gh-857 block, ~line 2696). Any fail-safe miss (a kicker run active on the head at tick time, no app token, a degraded probe) leaves the zombie in place.
- **failure / superseded / cancelled / died** — NO close path exists at all. The gh-865 block (~line 2661) detects the numeric-id orphan twin (pending check whose owning run concluded) but the in-place conclusion is gated on the same green-cover condition; without a cover, orphan-only heads "fall through to the legacy dispatch below" — a same-sha re-dispatch that gh-865's own comment says cannot cure "a stamp nothing will ever conclude". Link-less placeholders without a cover burn the capped gh-852 fresh-sha reset (3 per 2h) and then PARK the PR.

{"content":"# gh-998 — RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: A placeholder check-run in `in_progress`/`queued` whose owning workflow run has already terminated becomes unreachable state — it pins `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` forever and no machine action can merge the PR.

**Root cause**: In this repo, the SM tick itself registers the long-lived pending placeholder stamps (`stampValidationChecksForModule(..., 'in_progress', null, null)` — js/smAgent.js, the validate-pr arm at ~line 2877, the gh-852 fresh-sha reset at ~line 2835, and the gh-821 zombie re-dispatch at ~line 3496). The close obligation for those placeholders is only honored on ONE of the cycle's five outcomes:

- **success** — closed in place, but ONLY when the head additionally carries a completed-success dispatched validation run (`greenCoverRun`) AND no active run AND `silentToken` is configured (gh-857 block, ~line 2696). Any fail-safe miss (a kicker run active on the head at tick time, no app token, a degraded probe) leaves the zombie in place.
- **failure / superseded / cancelled / died** — NO close path exists at all. The gh-865 block (~line 2661) detects the numeric-id orphan twin (pending check whose owning run concluded) but the in-place conclusion is gated on the same green-cover condition; without a cover, orphan-only heads "fall through to the legacy dispatch below" — a same-sha re-dispatch that gh-865's own comment says cannot cure "a stamp nothing will ever conclude". Link-less placeholders without a cover burn the capped gh-852 fresh-sha reset (3 per 2h) and then PARK the PR.
- **pre-fix leaks** — no sweeper exists; zombies minted before this fix stay `in_progress` on their SHA forever (platform auto-fail is unreliable; operator REST close 404s — creator-only, I4).

The live instance (fa #1563, 2026-10-17, head `f3d58647`): kicker-suite 105847141092 created by the push at 18:15:41Z; placeholder `Quality gate` (check-run 117469671401) registered 18:24:18Z stayed `in_progress` 40+ minutes past its cycle while a genuine `Quality gate: success` existed from the real CI run — PR hard-stuck at BLOCKED; operator could not close it via REST (404 creator-only).

**Impact**: any PR whose validation cycle ends without landing a verdict stamp on the head (superseded by a newer head, cancelled, dup dispatch, tick death between arm and verdict) keeps a pending required check pinned on its current head. GitHub computes required-check state per name across ALL suites on the head, so one zombie holds BLOCKED even with 58 green siblings. The merge bot waits `checks=pending` every tick; the branch is not behind so no re-validation cycle helps.

**Fix approach** (per the ticket's tiered inventory, defaults Q1–Q3):
1. **Finally-path, no-verdict rows (core, this repo)**: when the head carries terminal-owner orphans (gh-865 detector — pending check-run whose owning run concluded, past the propagation grace) and the cycle left NO verdict (no green cover) and NO active run on the head (gh-857 AC2 fail-safe), force-complete the orphans as **`neutral`** under the cycle's own app token (I3: a superseded/dead cycle carries no verdict about its head; I4: same-app token, no cross-app completion). Link-less placeholders deliberately keep the gh-852 fresh-sha reset semantics (a same-sha re-dispatch re-mints THEM — only a fresh head cures that pathology; gh-852 AC3). A `neutral` close is honest but not a green verdict, so the PR still re-validates through the existing legacy dispatch path.
2. **Sweeper (heals pre-fix leaks, per-SM-tick piggyback Q2)**: the same neutral close runs per tick for any terminal-owner zombie the tick's probes surface — bounded to the PRs the validate-pr rule already visits, zero new infra.
3. **Observability (I5)**: every sweep action emits the machine-log line `zombie-swept: <check-run-id> head <sha>`; a cumulative `zombiesSwept` counter rides the factory-state snapshot (`buildFactoryState`) so operators see the leak rate.
4. **Lifecycle contract (AC1, pure)**: `CYCLE_OUTCOME_CONCLUSIONS` + `closePlaceholderCycle()` — the register→outcome→closed state machine over the five outcomes with the ticket's conclusion table (success→success, failure→failure, superseded/cancelled/died→neutral); no transition leaves the object open; unknown outcomes fail safe (stay open, retry next tick); a closed cycle cannot re-close (idempotence, E1).

{"content":"# gh-998 — RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: A placeholder check-run in `in_progress`/`queued` whose owning workflow run has already terminated becomes unreachable state — it pins `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` forever and no machine action can merge the PR.

**Root cause**: In this repo, the SM tick itself registers the long-lived pending placeholder stamps (`stampValidationChecksForModule(..., 'in_progress', null, null)` — js/smAgent.js, the validate-pr arm at ~line 2877, the gh-852 fresh-sha reset at ~line 2835, and the gh-821 zombie re-dispatch at ~line 3496). The close obligation for those placeholders is only honored on ONE of the cycle's five outcomes:

- **success** — closed in place, but ONLY when the head additionally carries a completed-success dispatched validation run (`greenCoverRun`) AND no active run AND `silentToken` is configured (gh-857 block, ~line 2696). Any fail-safe miss (a kicker run active on the head at tick time, no app token, a degraded probe) leaves the zombie in place.
- **failure / superseded / cancelled / died** — NO close path exists at all. The gh-865 block (~line 2661) detects the numeric-id orphan twin (pending check whose owning run concluded) but the in-place conclusion is gated on the same green-cover condition; without a cover, orphan-only heads "fall through to the legacy dispatch below" — a same-sha re-dispatch that gh-865's own comment says cannot cure "a stamp nothing will ever conclude". Link-less placeholders without a cover burn the capped gh-852 fresh-sha reset (3 per 2h) and then PARK the PR.
- **pre-fix leaks** — no sweeper exists; zombies minted before this fix stay `in_progress` on their SHA forever (platform auto-fail is unreliable; operator REST close 404s — creator-only, I4).

The live instance (fa #1563, 2026-10-17, head `f3d58647`): kicker-suite 105847141092 created by the push at 18:15:41Z; placeholder `Quality gate` (check-run 117469671401) registered 18:24:18Z stayed `in_progress` 40+ minutes past its cycle while a genuine `Quality gate: success` existed from the real CI run — PR hard-stuck at BLOCKED; operator could not close it via REST (404 creator-only).

**Impact**: any PR whose validation cycle ends without landing a verdict stamp on the head (superseded by a newer head, cancelled, dup dispatch, tick death between arm and verdict) keeps a pending required check pinned on its current head. GitHub computes required-check state per name across ALL suites on the head, so one zombie holds BLOCKED even with 58 green siblings. The merge bot waits `checks=pending` every tick; the branch is not behind so no re-validation cycle helps.

**Fix approach** (per the ticket's tiered inventory, defaults Q1–Q3):
1. **Finally-path, no-verdict rows (core, this repo)**: when the head carries terminal-owner orphans (gh-865 detector — pending check-run whose owning run concluded, past the propagation grace) and the cycle left NO verdict (no green cover) and NO active run on the head (gh-857 AC2 fail-safe), force-complete the orphans as **`neutral`** under the cycle's own app token (I3: a superseded/dead cycle carries no verdict about its head; I4: same-app token, no cross-app completion). Link-less placeholders deliberately keep the gh-852 fresh-sha reset semantics (a same-sha re-dispatch re-mints THEM — only a fresh head cures that pathology; gh-852 AC3). A `neutral` close is honest but not a green verdict, so the PR still re-validates through the existing legacy dispatch path.
2. **Sweeper (heals pre-fix leaks, per-SM-tick piggyback Q2)**: the same neutral close runs per tick for any terminal-owner zombie the tick's probes surface — bounded to the PRs the validate-pr rule already visits, zero new infra.
3. **Observability (I5)**: every sweep action emits the machine-log line `zombie-swept: <check-run-id> head <sha>`; a cumulative `zombiesSwept` counter rides the factory-state snapshot (`buildFactoryState`) so operators see the leak rate.
4. **Lifecycle contract (AC1, pure)**: `CYCLE_OUTCOME_CONCLUSIONS` + `closePlaceholderCycle()` — the register→outcome→closed state machine over the five outcomes with the ticket's conclusion table (success→success, failure→failure, superseded/cancelled/died→neutral); no transition leaves the object open; unknown outcomes fail safe (stay open, retry next tick); a closed cycle cannot re-close (idempotence, E1).

**Previous attempt**: none in this leg — fresh bug (the gh-842/852/857/865 family are sibling remedies for adjacent shapes; each left the no-verdict rows of the gh-998 table unclosed).

{"content":"# gh-998 — RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: A placeholder check-run in `in_progress`/`queued` whose owning workflow run has already terminated becomes unreachable state — it pins `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` forever and no machine action can merge the PR.

**Root cause**: In this repo, the SM tick itself registers the long-lived pending placeholder stamps (`stampValidationChecksForModule(..., 'in_progress', null, null)` — js/smAgent.js, the validate-pr arm at ~line 2877, the gh-852 fresh-sha reset at ~line 2835, and the gh-821 zombie re-dispatch at ~line 3496). The close obligation for those placeholders is only honored on ONE of the cycle's five outcomes:

- **success** — closed in place, but ONLY when the head additionally carries a completed-success dispatched validation run (`greenCoverRun`) AND no active run AND `silentToken` is configured (gh-857 block, ~line 2696). Any fail-safe miss (a kicker run active on the head at tick time, no app token, a degraded probe) leaves the zombie in place.
- **failure / superseded / cancelled / died** — NO close path exists at all. The gh-865 block (~line 2661) detects the numeric-id orphan twin (pending check whose owning run concluded) but the in-place conclusion is gated on the same green-cover condition; without a cover, orphan-only heads "fall through to the legacy dispatch below" — a same-sha re-dispatch that gh-865's own comment says cannot cure "a stamp nothing will ever conclude". Link-less placeholders without a cover burn the capped gh-852 fresh-sha reset (3 per 2h) and then PARK the PR.
- **pre-fix leaks** — no sweeper exists; zombies minted before this fix stay `in_progress` on their SHA forever (platform auto-fail is unreliable; operator REST close 404s — creator-only, I4).

The live instance (fa #1563, 2026-10-17, head `f3d58647`): kicker-suite 105847141092 created by the push at 18:15:41Z; placeholder `Quality gate` (check-run 117469671401) registered 18:24:18Z stayed `in_progress` 40+ minutes past its cycle while a genuine `Quality gate: success` existed from the real CI run — PR hard-stuck at BLOCKED; operator could not close it via REST (404 creator-only).

**Impact**: any PR whose validation cycle ends without landing a verdict stamp on the head (superseded by a newer head, cancelled, dup dispatch, tick death between arm and verdict) keeps a pending required check pinned on its current head. GitHub computes required-check state per name across ALL suites on the head, so one zombie holds BLOCKED even with 58 green siblings. The merge bot waits `checks=pending` every tick; the branch is not behind so no re-validation cycle helps.

**Fix approach** (per the ticket's tiered inventory, defaults Q1–Q3):
1. **Finally-path, no-verdict rows (core, this repo)**: when the head carries terminal-owner orphans (gh-865 detector — pending check-run whose owning run concluded, past the propagation grace) and the cycle left NO verdict (no green cover) and NO active run on the head (gh-857 AC2 fail-safe), force-complete the orphans as **`neutral`** under the cycle's own app token (I3: a superseded/dead cycle carries no verdict about its head; I4: same-app token, no cross-app completion). Link-less placeholders deliberately keep the gh-852 fresh-sha reset semantics (a same-sha re-dispatch re-mints THEM — only a fresh head cures that pathology; gh-852 AC3). A `neutral` close is honest but not a green verdict, so the PR still re-validates through the existing legacy dispatch path.
2. **Sweeper (heals pre-fix leaks, per-SM-tick piggyback Q2)**: the same neutral close runs per tick for any terminal-owner zombie the tick's probes surface — bounded to the PRs the validate-pr rule already visits, zero new infra.
3. **Observability (I5)**: every sweep action emits the machine-log line `zombie-swept: <check-run-id> head <sha>`; a cumulative `zombiesSwept` counter rides the factory-state snapshot (`buildFactoryState`) so operators see the leak rate.
4. **Lifecycle contract (AC1, pure)**: `CYCLE_OUTCOME_CONCLUSIONS` + `closePlaceholderCycle()` — the register→outcome→closed state machine over the five outcomes with the ticket's conclusion table (success→success, failure→failure, superseded/cancelled/died→neutral); no transition leaves the object open; unknown outcomes fail safe (stay open, retry next tick); a closed cycle cannot re-close (idempotence, E1).

**Previous attempt**: none in this leg — fresh bug (the gh-842/852/857/865 family are sibling remedies for adjacent shapes; each left the no-verdict rows of the gh-998 table unclosed).

{"content":"# gh-998 — RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: A placeholder check-run in `in_progress`/`queued` whose owning workflow run has already terminated becomes unreachable state — it pins `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` forever and no machine action can merge the PR.

**Root cause**: In this repo, the SM tick itself registers the long-lived pending placeholder stamps (`stampValidationChecksForModule(..., 'in_progress', null, null)` — js/smAgent.js, the validate-pr arm at ~line 2877, the gh-852 fresh-sha reset at ~line 2835, and the gh-821 zombie re-dispatch at ~line 3496). The close obligation for those placeholders is only honored on ONE of the cycle's five outcomes:

- **success** — closed in place, but ONLY when the head additionally carries a completed-success dispatched validation run (`greenCoverRun`) AND no active run AND `silentToken` is configured (gh-857 block, ~line 2696). Any fail-safe miss (a kicker run active on the head at tick time, no app token, a degraded probe) leaves the zombie in place.
- **failure / superseded / cancelled / died** — NO close path exists at all. The gh-865 block (~line 2661) detects the numeric-id orphan twin (pending check whose owning run concluded) but the in-place conclusion is gated on the same green-cover condition; without a cover, orphan-only heads "fall through to the legacy dispatch below" — a same-sha re-dispatch that gh-865's own comment says cannot cure "a stamp nothing will ever conclude". Link-less placeholders without a cover burn the capped gh-852 fresh-sha reset (3 per 2h) and then PARK the PR.

{"content":"# gh-998 — RCA

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: A placeholder check-run in `in_progress`/`queued` whose owning workflow run has already terminated becomes unreachable state — it pins `mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED` forever and no machine action can merge the PR.

**Root cause**: In this repo, the SM tick itself registers the long-lived pending placeholder stamps (`stampValidationChecksForModule(..., 'in_progress', null, null)` — js/smAgent.js, the validate-pr arm at ~line 2877, the gh-852 fresh-sha reset at ~line 2835, and the gh-821 zombie re-dispatch at ~line 3496). The close obligation for those placeholders is only honored on ONE of the cycle's five outcomes:

- **success** — closed in place, but ONLY when the head additionally carries a completed-success dispatched validation run (`greenCoverRun`) AND no active run AND `silentToken` is configured (gh-857 block, ~line 2696). Any fail-safe miss (a kicker run active on the head at tick time, no app token, a degraded probe) leaves the zombie in place.
- **failure / superseded / cancelled / died** — NO close path exists at all. The gh-865 block (~line 2661) detects the numeric-id orphan twin (pending check whose owning run concluded) but the in-place conclusion is gated on the same green-cover condition; without a cover, orphan-only heads "fall through to the legacy dispatch below" — a same-sha re-dispatch that gh-865's own comment says cannot cure "a stamp nothing will ever conclude". Link-less placeholders without a cover burn the capped gh-852 fresh-sha reset (3 per 2h) and then PARK the PR.
- **pre-fix leaks** — no sweeper exists; zombies minted before this fix stay `in_progress` on their SHA forever (platform auto-fail is unreliable; operator REST close 404s — creator-only, I4).

The live instance (fa #1563, 2026-10-17, head `f3d58647`): kicker-suite 105847141092 created by the push at 18:15:41Z; placeholder `Quality gate` (check-run 117469671401) registered 18:24:18Z stayed `in_progress` 40+ minutes past its cycle while a genuine `Quality gate: success` existed from the real CI run — PR hard-stuck at BLOCKED; operator could not close it via REST (404 creator-only).

**Impact**: any PR whose validation cycle ends without landing a verdict stamp on the head (superseded by a newer head, cancelled, dup dispatch, tick death between arm and verdict) keeps a pending required check pinned on its current head. GitHub computes required-check state per name across ALL suites on the head, so one zombie holds BLOCKED even with 58 green siblings. The merge bot waits `checks=pending` every tick; the branch is not behind so no re-validation cycle helps.

**Fix approach** (per the ticket's tiered inventory, defaults Q1–Q3):
1. **Finally-path, no-verdict rows (core, this repo)**: when the head carries terminal-owner orphans (gh-865 detector — pending check-run whose owning run concluded, past the propagation grace) and the cycle left NO verdict (no green cover) and NO active run on the head (gh-857 AC2 fail-safe), force-complete the orphans as **`neutral`** under the cycle's own app token (I3: a superseded/dead cycle carries no verdict about its head; I4: same-app token, no cross-app completion). Link-less placeholders deliberately keep the gh-852 fresh-sha reset semantics (a same-sha re-dispatch re-mints THEM — only a fresh head cures that pathology; gh-852 AC3). A `neutral` close is honest but not a green verdict, so the PR still re-validates through the existing legacy dispatch path.
2. **Sweeper (heals pre-fix leaks, per-SM-tick piggyback Q2)**: the same neutral close runs per tick for any terminal-owner zombie the tick's probes surface — bounded to the PRs the validate-pr rule already visits, zero new infra.
3. **Observability (I5)**: every sweep action emits the machine-log line `zombie-swept: <check-run-id> head <sha>`; a cumulative `zombiesSwept` counter rides the factory-state snapshot (`buildFactoryState`) so operators see the leak rate.
4. **Lifecycle contract (AC1, pure)**: `CYCLE_OUTCOME_CONCLUSIONS` + `closePlaceholderCycle()` — the register→outcome→closed state machine over the five outcomes with the ticket's conclusion table (success→success, failure→failure, superseded/cancelled/died→neutral); no transition leaves the object open; unknown outcomes fail safe (stay open, retry next tick); a closed cycle cannot re-close (idempotence, E1).

**Previous attempt**: none in this leg — fresh bug (the gh-842/852/857/865 family are sibling remedies for adjacent shapes; each left the no-verdict rows of the gh-998 table unclosed).

+/** The close conclusion for a cycle outcome; null for an unknown outcome. */

+    if (!CYCLE_OUTCOME_CONCLUSIONS.hasOwnProperty(outcome)) return null;
+    return CYCLE_OUTCOME_CONCLUSIONS[outcome];

Now let me do a final review of the complete diff, then check `git status` for stray files, and write outputs/response.md. Also verify the sweper is genuinely reachable — double-check the branch conditions: the sweep fires when:
- silentToken configured
- phHeadRuns probed OK and NO active run on head
- no green cover (else the gh-857 success path ran... wait — if phCover is null AND vPh non-empty AND vOrphans non-empty: sweep concludes ONLY the orphans, then falls to the reset block for vPh. Correct per design.)

One more check — in the phCover branch (success conclude), if phConc fails partially (rejected), it falls to the reset. Unchanged.

Edge: the sweep runs even when vProbe is green but phCover probe failed (greenCoverRun returned null) — then vOrphans get swept neutral. Hmm: vProbe.green true means the rollup probe saw green, but greenCoverRun (dispatch-filtered) found no completed-success dispatched run — degraded/inconsistent probe; sweeping neutral under a genuinely-green head could turn a green gate neutral and BLOCK a mergeable PR! Wait — can that happen? If the head has a real green verdict, the orphan should be concluded as SUCCESS (mirror), not neutral. If phCover failed (null) but vProbe.green is true, my sweep would conclude the orphans neutral, which for a required check is not-success → could flip a green PR to blocked!

Hmm. Is that a real risk? greenCoverRun fails only on exception (fail-closed null). vProbe.green — what is vProbe? It's the rollup probe earlier in validate_pr. If vProbe.green && greenCoverRun throws → sweep neutral → regression risk. How does the OLD code handle this? Old: `if (vProbe.green && silentToken)` → probe runs → phCover null → nothing (no conclusion, no reset for orphan-only heads → legacy dispatch). So old behavior: leave zombie, re-dispatch. New behavior with my change: conclude orphans NEUTRAL even though the head is (probe-)green. That's a behavior change in a corner case — and arguably wrong per gh-857's philosophy (mirror the real verdict: green cover → success).

Guard: only sweep when NOT vProbe.green. That keeps the corner case exactly as the old code (fall through to legacy dispatch). Let me tighten the condition: `else if (vOrphans && vOrphans.length && !(vProbe && vProbe.green))`.

Hmm, but wait: if vProbe.green is true and phCover is null (probe inconsistency), the orphans stay — next tick retries. Fine — fail safe.

Also consider: vProbe.green false but the head genuinely has green dispatched run — greenCoverRun would find it → phCover non-null → success conclude. So the sweep only fires when there's genuinely no green verdict. 

Let me apply that guard.

### Root Cause
A placeholder check-run in `in_progress` whose owning workflow run terminated had no close path for four of the five cycle outcomes: the gh-857 in-place conclusion only mirrors a **green** verdict (and only with a probed green cover, no active head run, and an app token). Failure/superseded/cancelled/died cycles and all pre-fix leaks left the zombie pinned to its SHA — mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED forever (live fa #1563, head `f3d58647`, check-run 117469671401), and the legacy same-sha re-dispatch cannot conclude a stamp nothing will conclude.

### Fix
- `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` — gh-998 lifecycle contract: `CYCLE_OUTCOME_CONCLUSIONS` + `conclusionForOutcome` (capability table), `openCycle`/`closePlaceholderCycle` (AC1 state machine over the five outcomes; unknown outcome fails safe, double-close rejected — E1 idempotence), `zombieSweptLine` (I5 log format).
- `js/smAgent.js` — gh-998 neutral sweep in the validate-pr placeholder/orphan block: terminal-owner orphans (gh-865 detector) whose cycle left no verdict are force-completed as `neutral` under the cycle's own app token (I3/I4), with the gh-857 AC2 fail-safes unchanged (no active head run; green-probe corner falls through untouched). New transport `sweepZombieCheckRunsNeutral` emits `zombie-swept: <id> head <sha>` per close; rejections retry next tick (E2). Per-tick counter reset in `action()`.
- `js/factoryState.js` — cumulative `zombiesSwept` rides the state snapshot (I5); smAgent passes the tick count at the `buildFactoryState` call site.
- Link-less placeholders deliberately keep the gh-852 fresh-sha reset (a same-sha re-dispatch re-mints them — only a fresh head cures that pathology, gh-852 AC3).

### Test Coverage
- `js/unit-tests/test_checkRunZombies.js` — 8 new tests: conclusion mapping, five-outcome lifecycle (incl. 3-placeholder multi-item), fail-safe unknown outcome, idempotent double-close rejection, `zombie-swept` log line. RED first (8 failed), GREEN after implementation.
- `js/unit-tests/test_factoryState.js` — 4 new tests: stable-shape 0, tick count, cumulative carry, malformed-carry restart.
- Full suite `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json`: **3590 passed, 0 failed** (clean-env re-run: 3538 passed, 0 failed — delta is env-dependent skips; new suites pass 49/49 and 145/145 standalone).

### Notes
- The creation-side finally-path for the kicker stub (Q1, shared helper) and the E2E/REG sandbox scenarios (AC4/AC5) live in the factory/kicker repos and CI — out of this repo's reach; this change is the SM-side finally-path + sweper (Q2 per-tick piggyback) + observability.
- A `neutral` close is honest but not a green verdict: the PR still re-validates through the existing legacy dispatch path — no required-check truth is laundered (I3).

+// `Quality gate` (check-run 117469671401, kicker suite 105847141092) stayed
+// `in_progress` 40+ minutes past its cycle and held mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED
+// with 58 green sibling checks — a pending required check counts per name
+// across ALL suites on the head, and no machine action (re-dispatch, fresh
+// sha, operator REST close — 404 creator-only) can retire it. The gh-857
+// in-place close covers ONLY the success row (and only with a green cover);
+// the failure/superseded/cancelled/died rows of the gh-998 capability table
+// and every pre-fix leak had NO close path — a cycle that ends without
+// landing a verdict stamp on the head leaks its placeholders forever.
+//
+//  - conclusionForOutcome(outcome) — the capability table (AC1): the
+//    cycle's real outcome decides the close conclusion. `neutral` is
+//    reserved for the no-verdict rows (superseded/cancelled/died) — a
+//    superseded cycle carries no verdict about its head (I3); required-
+//    check truth is never laundered into a blanket success.
+//  - openCycle/closePlaceholderCycle — the register→outcome→closed state
+//    machine (AC1): the five outcomes close with the mapped conclusion and
+//    NO transition leaves the object open. An unknown outcome fails SAFE
+//    (returns null, the cycle stays open — the close obligation retries
+//    next tick, it is never silently dropped). Closing an already-closed
+//    cycle is rejected — idempotence, so two racing closers (E1) cannot
+//    double-close or double-count the metric.
+//  - zombieSweptLine — the I5 machine-log line for every sweeper action:
+//    `zombie-swept: <check-run-id> head <sha>`. The sweeper's DETECTION is
+//    the gh-865 orphan rule (a pending check-run whose owning run is
+//    terminal, past the propagation grace) — reused verbatim; its AC2
+//    guarantee (a live owner is never touched) is the gh-865 test suite.

+// wiring live in js/smAgent.js; the leak counter rides the factory-state
+// snapshot (js/factoryState.js, I5).
+
+// gh-998 capability table (AC1). Keys are the five cycle outcomes; values
+// are the placeholder close conclusions. `neutral` is deliberate for the
+// no-verdict rows — see above.
+var CYCLE_OUTCOME_CONCLUSIONS = {
+    success: 'success',
+    failure: 'failure',
+    superseded: 'neutral',
+    cancelled: 'neutral',
+    died: 'neutral'
+};
+
+/** The close conclusion for a cycle outcome; null for an unknown outcome. */
+function conclusionForOutcome(outcome) {
+    if (!CYCLE_OUTCOME_CONCLUSIONS.hasOwnProperty(outcome)) return null;
+    return CYCLE_OUTCOME_CONCLUSIONS[outcome];
+}
+
+/**
+ * A fresh validation cycle: placeholders registered, nothing concluded yet.
+ * @param placeholders [{name, id?}] — the registered placeholder check-runs
+ */
+function openCycle(placeholders) {
+    return { state: 'open', placeholders: (placeholders || []).slice() };
+}
+
+/**
+ * The finally-path transition (AC1): 'open' + outcome → 'closed' with the
+ * mapped conclusion. Returns null (no transition taken) when the cycle is
+ * not open or the outcome is unknown — the object can only reach 'closed',
+ * never back to open, and never linger open through a KNOWN outcome.
+ */
+function closePlaceholderCycle(cycle, outcome) {
+    if (!cycle || cycle.state !== 'open') return null;
+    var conclusion = conclusionForOutcome(outcome);
+    if (conclusion === null) return null;
+    return {
+        state: 'closed',
+        conclusion: conclusion,
+        outcome: outcome,
+        placeholders: (cycle.placeholders || []).slice()
+    };
+}
+
+/** I5: the machine-log line for one sweeper action. */
+function zombieSweptLine(checkRunId, headSha) {
+    return 'zombie-swept: ' + checkRunId + ' head ' + headSha;
+}

{"content":"### Root Cause
A placeholder check-run in `in_progress` whose owning workflow run terminated had no close path for four of the five cycle outcomes: the gh-857 in-place conclusion only mirrors a **green** verdict (and only with a probed green cover, no active head run, and an app token). Failure/superseded/cancelled/died cycles and all pre-fix leaks left the zombie pinned to its SHA — mergeStateStatus=BLOCKED forever (live fa #1563, head `f3d58647`, check-run 117469671401), and the legacy same-sha re-dispatch cannot conclude a stamp nothing will conclude.

### Fix
- `js/common/checkRunZombies.js` — gh-998 lifecycle contract: `CYCLE_OUTCOME_CONCLUSIONS` + `conclusionForOutcome` (capability table), `openCycle`/`closePlaceholderCycle` (AC1 state machine over the five outcomes; unknown outcome fails safe, double-close rejected — E1 idempotence), `zombieSweptLine` (I5 log format).
- `js/smAgent.js` — gh-998 neutral sweep in the validate-pr placeholder/orphan block: terminal-owner orphans (gh-865 detector) whose cycle left no verdict are force-completed as `neutral` under the cycle's own app token (I3/I4), with the gh-857 AC2 fail-safes unchanged (no active head run; green-probe corner falls through untouched). New transport `sweepZombieCheckRunsNeutral` emits `zombie-swept: <id> head <sha>` per close; rejections retry next tick (E2). Per-tick counter reset in `action()`.
- `js/factoryState.js` — cumulative `zombiesSwept` rides the state snapshot (I5); smAgent passes the tick count at the `buildFactoryState` call site.
- Link-less placeholders deliberately keep the gh-852 fresh-sha reset (a same-sha re-dispatch re-mints them — only a fresh head cures that pathology, gh-852 AC3).

### Test Coverage
- `js/unit-tests/test_checkRunZombies.js` — 8 new tests: conclusion mapping, five-outcome lifecycle (incl. 3-placeholder multi-item), fail-safe unknown outcome, idempotent double-close rejection, `zombie-swept` log line. RED first (8 failed), GREEN after implementation.
- `js/unit-tests/test_factoryState.js` — 4 new tests: stable-shape 0, tick count, cumulative carry, malformed-carry restart.
- Full suite `dmtools run js/unit-tests/run_all.json`: **3590 passed, 0 failed** (clean-env re-run: 3538 passed, 0 failed — delta is env-dependent skips; new suites pass 49/49 and 145/145 standalone).

### Notes
- The creation-side finally-path for the kicker stub (Q1, shared helper) and the E2E/REG sandbox scenarios (AC4/AC5) live in the factory/kicker repos and CI — out of this repo's reach; this change is the SM-side finally-path + sweper (Q2 per-tick piggyback) + observability.
- A `neutral` close is honest but not a green verdict: the PR still re-validates through the existing legacy dispatch path — no required-check truth is laundered (I3).
